editing_notes:
THE HOOK IS THE MOST IMPORTANT PART OF THIS AD. The first frame and first line must stop the scroll and make the problem obvious with the sound off. Spend the most time here, and redo it until it's undeniable.

Basically just 1:1, visual wise, except apply our castor oil roll-on. For all the visuals. Change the avatar slightly, same positions, same applications. Text overlays the same as the reference.

Added at the end: a clip of her holding the camera and showing her Haven & Spool roll-on bottle in the other hand ("I get mine from Haven and Spool"), then a checklist (Organic / Cold pressed / Hexane free / Amber glass bottle / Roll on for easy application), then the same avatar filming the bottle on a table with a Buy 1 Get 1 FREE pop-up card, her hand coming down and pointing down to click the link below.
